    Chart reading basics

    How a candlestick chart is read, what timeframes are, and why the candle close matters.

    • How to read a candlestick chart

      • Chart reading

      On a candlestick chart, each candle shows a single period, such as one hour or one day.

    • Timeframes: 15m, 1H, 4H, 1D, 1W

      • Chart reading

      A timeframe is the length of time a single candle covers on a chart: 15m is fifteen minutes, 1H one hour, 4H four hours, 1D one day and 1W one week.

    • Why the candle close matters

      • Chart reading

      A candle is not final until its timeframe is over.

    • Multi-timeframe analysis

      • Chart reading

      Multi-timeframe analysis means looking at the same chart on more than one timeframe.

    • When timeframes seem to disagree

      • Chart reading

      Price can be falling on the 1H chart while the rising structure holds on the 1D chart.
